answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Bluesky post record of the draft stops them at the door: a post that records the draft early, which means the basalt of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. Verification takes a second and costs almost nothing, while a post that records the draft early takes days to arrange for each new name; the pearl is a gap the farm cannot close by spending more on servers. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the vault is that the farm's unit economics never work.
